records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone despite two CSM emails and a held kickoff [email:37de03cf, email:d5573ef8, calendar:f10b4493]. Customer's only reply is a one-line "Will do, thanks" [email:29ddde22] -- polite but non-committal, no stated blocker or date. Starter plan, no tickets. Some intent exists, so unaided activation in 8 days is possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for the reply, and good to talk at the kickoff last week. No pressure on timing at all.

When you're ready, the usual first step is creating a first project -- in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time whenever you want the rest of North Dynamics in there.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you.

Best,
Nadia
